allow: Bash(osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to set frontmost of every process whose name is "DustEaterApp" to true')

Bash(
# Kill previous instances
pkill DustEaterApp 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1

# Run with output redirected
swift run DustEaterApp > /tmp/dusteater-run.log 2>&1 &
APPID=$!
echo "App PID: $APPID"

# Wait for scan to complete \(37-40 seconds\)
sleep 42

# Capture logs with timing info
echo "=== Timing Logs ==="
grep "📊" /tmp/dusteater-run.log | tail -10
)
